title: Star Cavalcade
prompt: Sample seed level. 'A vertical space shooter — wave after wave of grinning invader blobs, rack up 9000 points to save the parade.'
brief: Hold the line above the parade route. Waves ramp until BOSSCRAFT arrives — destroy it to win.
objective: Reach 9000 and destroy BOSSCRAFT before your shields fall. Pop elites for power-ups.
